about: A format sent to a model with more than 100 properties (chapter 2 § 2.3.1), each key of each properties object counted, a definition at each place it is referred to. The agent node plan returns the package format findings: 99 properties, and $defs/finding of one more. Invalid: second refers to #/$defs/finding as first does, 101. Valid: second is plaintext, 100, the limit.
